summary.description: 2-4 sentences: overall health of this slice and its main risks

kind.description: fix = defect with wrong behavior; improvement = works but should change

priority.description: 0 blocks release, 1 next cycle, 2 eventually, 3 nice to have

effort.description: S under an hour, M under a day, L more

problem.description: What is wrong, the input or state that triggers it, and the impact

evidence.description: How you confirmed it: code path traced, command run, test written

fix.description: Concrete change, with a short snippet when it helps
